question:
Select the appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Grasping at straws

options.text: Holding the last strands of straw

solution:
The correct answer is:** Desperate attempt to succeed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"Grasping at straws"** means making a desperate attempt to succeed or find a solution, especially when everything else has failed. (अंतिम उपाय के रूप में संघर्ष करना)

 
 
• **Example: **He was grasping at straws, trying to find any way to keep his business afloat.
 
 
 
• **"Desperate attempt to succeed" **refers to an action taken out of desperation in the hope of achieving success. (सफलता प्राप्त करने के लिए हताश प्रयास)
 
 
• **Example: **In a desperate attempt to succeed, she worked day and night to finish the project.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Desperate attempt to succeed.
